description: Defines the cbs_encoder_impl class implementing GSM-7 and UCS-2 encoding for CBS messages, including methods for encoding data and selecting encoding types.

classes.name: cbs_encoder_impl
classes.description: Implements GSM-7 and UCS-2 encoding for CBS messages, derived from cbs_encoder.

methods.name: encode_cb_data
methods.description: Encodes CBS message data using specified data coding scheme.

methods.name: select_cbs_encoding
methods.description: Selects encoding type based on data coding scheme.

methods.name: fill_cb_data_gsm7
methods.description: Encodes message in GSM-7 format, supporting default alphabet and extension table.

methods.name: fill_cb_data_ucs2
methods.description: Encodes message in UCS-2 format supporting all Unicode code points in BMP.
